chunks: He will surely not bid you make the angels and the prophets your lords. Would he order you disbelief after you have submitted (and accepted the law of God)?
ai.seo_question: Why did God not command us to worship angels and prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal in distinguishing between the veneration of prophets and angels and the absolute monotheism (Tawhid) of God, particularly in debates against those who elevated Ali or the Imams to divine status. The rhetorical structure underscores that true Islam requires exclusive worship of Allah, rejecting any intermediary who might be worshipped as a lord (Rabb). This reinforces the concept of 'La ilaha illa Allah' by negating lordship in created beings while affirming their status as servants and guides.
